name: boardcheck
description: Flags deceptive signals in AI-agent marketplace listings, from fake engagement to prompt injection
long_description: Boardcheck runs eight checks with stable IDs (AMS-001 to AMS-008) on AI-agent marketplace listings: fabricated engagement, batch-seeded listings, supply-glut boards, unpaid-work risk, high-budget bait, prompt-injection text, upfront fees without escrow, and bounty bait written for agents (requests for keys, download-and-run scripts, hidden text). It runs locally over stdio with no API key, and its tools send nothing anywhere (uv fetches Python and the mcp package on first start).

tools.name: scan_listings
tools.description: Run all eight checks (AMS-001 to AMS-008) on a batch of listings and return findings, a verdict, a severity summary and data coverage.

tools.name: check_listing
tools.description: Check one listing, such as a bounty issue, before bidding on or working on it: fabricated interest (AMS-001), unpaid-work risk (AMS-004), prompt-injection text (AMS-006), an upfront fee without escrow (AMS-007) and bounty bait written for agents (AMS-008).

tools.name: list_indicators
tools.description: List the AMS-* indicators with their IDs, names, maximum severities and plain-language summaries.

tools.name: make_observation
tools.description: Opt-in: turn a scan into a coarse, privacy-preserving summary that may be shared by hand. Sends nothing.

tools.name: generate_audit_certificate
tools.description: Turn a scan into an unsigned JSON audit summary with Markdown and HTML badge snippets.
